name: Interlocking vertical teeth / dovetail TPU<->CF joint
mechanism: Mechanical interlock carries the centrifugal pull across the TPU-rigid interface by bearing on teeth instead of adhesion; addresses the root-fitting failure (FEA util 4.8).
needs: FEA of joint detail: multi-part solids with interface/contact (or tied) + toothed interface geometry generator; beam model treats connectors as rigid

name: Free-floating blade-to-blade through rod (hub not in the load path)
mechanism: One rod runs blade 1 -> hub -> blade 2, only located (not clamped) by the hub, so the two centrifugal pulls cancel inside the rod; hub carries ~0 radial load.
needs: members connecting blade k to blade j (cross-blade members / non-hub endpoints) in rotor.py; sliding/pinned hub support

name: Graded TPU hardness / functionally graded root (95A hinge -> 64D -> PA6-CF)
mechanism: Modulus graded along the span so strain concentrates in the hinge zone and stress steps at interfaces vanish.
needs: spanwise material grading per member element (beam) and per-element material in FEA

name: FACT seed -> free-form FEA topology optimisation
mechanism: Start from the best FACT layout and let density-based TO redistribute material under centrifugal + 1/rev loads.
needs: FEA-in-the-loop harmonic objective (in progress in the free-form optimiser agent)

name: Butterfly pivot / two-stage (series) flexure
mechanism: Two flexure stages in series through an intermediate rigid body: one stage gives lag compliance, the other carries pull / sets the skewed axis; large stroke, low axis drift.
needs: member chains with intermediate rigid bodies (node sharing between members) in rotor/fact

name: Swept blade (pitch-lag via sweep/offset of the blade line)
mechanism: Aft/forward sweep moves the blade CG/aero centre off the lag hinge line so lag and centrifugal force produce pitch moment; no skewed hinge needed.
needs: sweep field per BladeStation (beam line offset in y) in schema/bladegeom/rotor/geometry

name: Aeroelastic bend-twist coupled blade (off-axis fibres), no root pitch hinge
mechanism: Lag bending of an anisotropic blade twists it (EI-GJ coupling from off-axis fibre/raster); root only needs lag compliance.
needs: coupled section stiffness (bend-twist terms) in section.py/beam.py

name: Lattice / auxetic metamaterial hinge block
mechanism: Printed lattice with tailored anisotropic homogenised stiffness: soft about the skewed axis, stiff radially; auxetic cells resist necking.
needs: homogenised lattice materials + lattice geometry export

name: Continuous-fibre steered loops (CF/aramid/GF filament)
mechanism: Continuous fibre wrapped as a loop around hub pin and blade root carries pull in pure tension; TPU/PA hinge filler.
needs: continuous-fibre, aramid and GF materials; curved member paths

name: Tuned inertial tab / pendulum on the blade root
mechanism: A small mass on a compliant tab is driven by hub angular acceleration and pushes pitch directly (amplifies response near its own resonance).
needs: lumped masses/inertias attachable to members or blade stations

name: Asymmetric chordwise mass (speed-sensitive pitch, maple-seed-like)
mechanism: Blades with opposite chordwise CG offsets pitch in opposite senses with Omega oscillation (propeller moment), giving differential 1/rev pitch without lag.

name: Corrugated / pleated resilin-like hinge
mechanism: Pleats lengthen the effective bending length (low k) while the pull runs straight through a stiff vein.
